verdicts.reason: A uses the banner shape properly, with a large bottle on the left and copy on the right, but 'WEEKEND ONLY' has moved below the body copy so the reading order is wrong. Its text block is also small and cramped inside the circle, with 'WEEKEND ONLY' and the CTA tight against the right edge. B mixes left-aligned copy with a centred bottle and CTA, and its body copy runs as one long line across the circle edge. B's bottle is also shrunk until it hardly reads as the product, with dead space on both sides, and its headline is undersized.
